paragraphs: R' Pinchas of Jaffa. Mentioned in Pesachim, chapter 1, end of halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The connected locator פ״א סה״א is expanded as chapter 1, end of halakhah 1. The second source line continues that citation; no daf 81 or separate unexplained fragment is added. No named edition is independently verified.
דיפו is read as “of Jaffa.” This contextual place reading supplies no independent personal identification. The abbreviated title remains R'.
